description: Powerful Tool: The BOSCH GSB 600 Corded Electric Impact Drill is a robust and long-lasting drill machine powered by a 600W motor. It is capable of handling demanding tasks and is designed to endure with its high-quality construction. Additionally, the new carbon brush incorporated into the drill contributes to its longevity. Variable Speed: The electric drill provides easy speed control, which is beneficial for precision work. When no load, the first gear can reach a rotation speed of up to 3000 rpm and can deliver as many as 48000 bpm. Rated Torque and Chuck Capacity: The electric corded impact drill offers a torque of 1.4 Nm, which is sufficient for standard drilling activities. The chuck, which secures the drill bit, accommodates bits with a maximum diameter of 13 millimeters mm. Forward/Reverse Rotation & Double Insulation: You can adjust the direction of the drill’s rotation, simplifying the process of drilling or removing bits. The drill features two layers of insulating material covering the live components, enhancing safety during use, and eliminating the need for grounding (connection to the earth for safety). Applications: The BOSCH electric corded impact drill is highly versatile, suitable for drilling into masonry such as bricks, metal, and wood. It can also be employed for hole sawing and driving screws into metal and wood. Scope of Supply: Upon purchasing this impact drill, you will also receive 4 pc concrete drill bits, 4 pc metal drill bits, 10 pc screwdriver bits, 4 pc wood drill bits. Warranty: The Warranty of this product is valid for 1 year from the invoice date (invoice copy needed for claims) by the brand. You can find more details about BOSCH Power Tools on India's toll-free customer service number and use the BOSCH BeConnected App on the packaging for extended warranty and rewards.
